item.title: DISENT-KWS: Teaching a Model to Unlearn Speaker Identity for Robust Keyword Spotting
item.description: A deep dive into DISENT-KWS, a 1.8M parameter model that disentangles phonetic content from speaker identity for robust custom word detection. We cover the architecture, the training pipeline, ablation results, and honest reflections on what worked, what did not, and where we would go next.
